I fixed the bug in `transpose` in `src/matrix.py`. All 5 tests pass now.

`transpose` used the row count for both dimensions, so it only worked on square matrices. On a 2×3 input it dropped the last column. I replaced it with `[list(col) for col in zip(*m)]`, which handles any rectangular shape.
